```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-rx-chain
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Simplified primary receive path of the Fairphone (Gen. 6) for band 1 or band 3, from the antenna to the digital I/Q interface. The I and Q paths of the direct-conversion receiver are drawn as one; the Q path uses a second mixer driven by the LO shifted by 90°."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.dsp as dsp

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=12, margin=0.5)

    elm.Antenna()
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit * 0.6)
    dpx = dsp.Filter(response='lp').label('diplexer\nLMH | UHB', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    sw = dsp.Box(w=1.6, h=1).label('antenna\nswitch')
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    flt = dsp.Filter(response='bp').label('B1/B3\nquadplexer', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit * 0.6)
    lsw = dsp.Box(w=1.2, h=1).label('SPnT')
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 4)
    lna = dsp.Amp().label('LNA', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 4)
    mux = dsp.Box(w=1.0, h=1).label('mux')
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit * 0.9)
    mix = dsp.Mixer().anchor('W').label('I/Q', loc='top', ofst=0.1)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3).at(mix.E)
    lpf = dsp.Filter(response='lp').label('LPF', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    adc = dsp.Adc().label('ADC', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit / 3)
    dsp_ = dsp.Box(w=1.4, h=1).label('DSP')
    qout = dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit * 0.75)
    elm.Label().at((qout.end[0] + 0.25, qout.end[1])).label('QLink', halign='left', valign='center')
    dsp.Arrow().down(d.unit * 0.9).at(mix.S).reverse()
    vco = dsp.OscillatorBox().right().anchor('N').label('LO (PLL)', loc='right', ofst=0.15)

    elm.EncircleBox([lsw, lna, mux], padx=0.2, pady=0.9).linestyle('--').label('LNA module (QLN5040)', loc='top')
    elm.EncircleBox([mix, lpf, adc, dsp_, vco], padx=0.6, pady=0.6).linestyle('--').label('RFIC (SDR735)', loc='top')
    elm.EncircleBox([dpx, sw, flt], padx=0.35, pady=0.9).linestyle(':').label('front-end components on the PCB', loc='top')
```
